messages:
Liam (Cloud Ops): Heads up — Vendor-Ops just pinged. APAC H100 pool looks ~50% for the next two maintenance windows. Need to decide if we want a soft reserve for our Wed night load tests.

Maria (Sourcing): @Liam can you share how many units we need for the test window?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Planning 2 H100s for the heavy batches (12h window). Noncritical jobs can be deferred. Prefer not to block the whole pipeline.

Vendor-Ops: ETA update — backlog is ~6–8 business days for committed racks. We can place a soft-hold now but it isn't binding; prioritization depends on signed PO.

Cheng (Infra): If commit isn't possible, we should fallback to A100 preemptible for the heavy runs. Will need routing + eviction handling.

Sara (Eng Manager): Load tests scheduled Wed 02:00–06:00 UTC. Can we shrink the test matrix instead of delaying? Some teams rely on the window.

Liam (Cloud Ops): Proposal: 1) Maria requests soft-hold for 2 H100s for two weeks; 2) Cheng adds routing fallback to A100 preemptible + reduced batch sizes for that window; 3) Run full test on soft-hold if vendor confirms early.

Maria (Sourcing): I'll request the soft-hold now and loop in Procurement. cc @Vendor-Ops — please mark 2 units as 'soft-hold' until 2135072000 (two weeks).

Vendor-Ops: Ack — marking 2 units soft-hold. Note: soft-hold does not guarantee exclusivity. Will update if anything changes.

Cheng (Infra): Quick example routing config for the fallback (canary-first):

```json
{
  "policy": "soft_reserve_fallback",
  "primary": "h100-pool",
  "fallback": "a100-preemptible",
  "max_batch": 8,
  "kv_cache": true
}
```

Liam (Cloud Ops): Cheng — can you push a canary to staging today? I'll watch latency/cost.

Cheng (Infra): Pushing now. Also left a quick check for current quota if anyone wants to validate: 

```
# list accelerator types in region
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=asia-east1 --filter="name~'h100'" --project=redwood-prod
```

Deploybot: deploy started for infra-config/soft-reserve-fallback -> env:staging.

Deploybot: deploy succeeded in 115s. Canary running.

Sara (Eng Manager): If canary looks green, plan prod rollout Fri 02:00–05:00 UTC. I'll trim the test matrix to core scenarios.

Liam (Cloud Ops): I'll add an alert: preemptible-eviction-rate > 20% during window -> auto-switch to smaller batches and throttle noncritical jobs.

Maria (Sourcing): Procurement asked for PO language to cover soft-hold. I'll draft and send by EOD.

Vendor-Ops: We'll update ETA if racks move forward. For transparency, posting vendor backlog: 3 committed racks queued, 4 pending validation.

Liam (Cloud Ops): TL;DR action items: Maria request soft-hold + PO note; Cheng push canary & validate; Sara confirm test subset; Vendor-Ops update ETA if anything changes. :thumbsup:

Cheng (Infra): Canary looks good so far — metrics stable.

Liam (Cloud Ops): Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the morning with alerts and the final schedule.
